reviews.text:
We wanted to find a place that really cared for our pets after having been to a different vet in the city which lacked thoroughness and warmth from the vets specifically.

I've never been to a more caring and considerate vet! They check-up via text after appointments and dote on our pets! Couldn't be more pleased or recommend them enough!

I love this Vet clinic. The staff is so kind, so accommodating, friendly and gentle. My dog is a reactive rescue from the streets of Korea, little jingo mix, and every-time we go to the vet, they really accommodate his space, they don't push the limit if my dog is not willing to go further with his check up. This place is perfect if you have a reactive dog. They answer any questions you might have. Our doctor is Jess and she is the best! Thank you guys for always making us feel welcome and cared for. :)

My boy Parker has been a patient with Dr. Sarah Armstrong since opening. Over the years, the practice has grown, but the quality of care remains the same.

Parker is treated like family and I highly recommend anyone in need of their services.
Great staff offering compassionate care. Always friendly and easy to deal with.
My dog Quinn visited Olympic Village Vet for the first time and they were excellent. Highly recommend.

Our dog Heedong visited this clinic several times over the course of a few months at the end of last year. His blood tests repeatedly showed significantly elevated inflammatory markers. Despite these persistent abnormalities, which I believe warranted further investigation such as an abdominal ultrasound, we were only referred to a neurologist because of his seizure history. At no point was abdominal imaging or liver disease discussed.

As his condition was not improving, we made the difficult decision to travel to Korea for a more comprehensive evaluation. Our final visit to this clinic was for a health check and travel paperwork. Looking back, Heedong already had ascites, but it was not detected.

Less than a week later, at our very first visit to a veterinary hospital in Korea, a comprehensive examination revealed a liver tumor measuring over 6 cm, along with ascites. For a 3.2 kg dog, this was devastating to learn, especially given how little time had passed between the two examinations.

I understand that medicine is not perfect and that not every illness can be diagnosed immediately. However, I believe earlier investigation may not have changed the outcome, but it could have given us more options and more time.

I want to emphasize that the nurses and staff were always kind, compassionate, and professional. My concern is solely with the veterinarian's clinical judgment.

It has taken me over six months to write this review because the loss of Heedong has been so heartbreaking. It breaks my heart knowing there were multiple opportunities to look deeper, but they were missed. I sincerely hope no other family has to experience this kind of loss.
Absolutely amazing Vet that actually listens and helps the best they can with great suggestions. 11/10
They genuinely love your fur fella friends. They care your pet like their family. My Mellow has been enjoying visiting the clinic.
These guys are the best. They’re super knowledgeable and helpful.  Special mention to Rachel who’s went above and beyond to help with something very specific for my dog.

I really want to put these guys on blast, but I'm not going to waste my energy.

All I can say is if you have a real problem,  beyond flea/tick medication.. don't go here.

Beware of unauthorised credit card charges!!!
Very grateful for the care, understanding, and compassion we received from the doctors and the staff.
The best team in town! Always friendly and pleasant to deal with. They care a lot about your pets and it shows. Thank you!

Overall, I’d rate this clinic about 4.5/5 stars. I’m very happy with the care Honey received. The location is convenient, the pricing is fair, and everyone I met was friendly and welcoming.

Dr. Elly was highly professional and did an excellent job with Honey’s surgery. I’m especially grateful to Angela—her kindness and genuine affection for Honey were very touching and made a stressful situation much easier. All of the staff I encountered were warm and helpful.

I agreed to have Honey’s nails trimmed during the visit because recently I accidentally cut her quick at home and made her bleed. Otherwise, even with a discount, I wouldn’t have chosen to have it done at the clinic. After we got home, I noticed a clear blood spot on a front nail, and several small blood spots showing through the bandage on a back paw (the paw that had been wrapped for surgery). Since the back paw was bandaged, I couldn’t see the nails directly, so it’s a concern rather than a certainty—but together it was still distressing.

Despite this, I’m very grateful for the clinic’s professionalism and care, and I’d still highly recommend them for anyone looking for a caring and skilled vet.
Very thoughtful and compassionate staff
Pleasant experience!  They let you go back to the bigger room where they do blood draws etc, which was helpful with my shy cat.  Staff has a really nice friendly vibe.  Transparent with pricing too.
We always receive great care at this clinic. They have been very helpful with my anxious dog.

They are very disorganized. Every time we went there we had to see a different person, and we'd get conflicting information. You get emails reminding you of appointments you don't have, and they randomly schedule appointments for you that you don't need and charge you exorbitantly for them. They also overschedule which leads to long wait times when you do bring your pet in, which can be very unpleasant. I don't recommend them

I'm really impressed with the staff and care provided at this clinic. They've gone above and beyond in their care in ways that I never thought to ask for, like letters summarizing what we discussed during our visit, follow up texts to check in, and inviting me to be present in the exam room for bloodwork and injections. They even brought out one of their own dogs to demonstrate how to administer medicine to my cat when I came in without him to pick it up.
Dr. Elly is patient and answered all my questions with compassion and enthusiasm both times I've come in. I don't feel judged when making decisions about my cat's care, including setting a financial limit on procedures. It truly feels collaborative and like we're working together toward the same goals for my cat's wellbeing. I have yet to come across staff there who aren't genuinely excited to see him and give him pets and cuddles (which he loves), whether it's the front desk staff, vet techs, or Dr. Elly.
So grateful to everyone at Olympic Village Veterinary Clinic! Without their help, my kitten Lin wouldn’t have survived FIP. Thank you for everything you’ve done — they’re truly the best!

I would have to say Olympic village veterinary is the most caring clinic i bring my dog the cause I know he'll have the best care and when I say we're going to the Vet he gets totally excited he never did that with other vets only Olympic village  thanks for everything and Bandit thanks you too. N

So grateful to Dr. Armstrong and the team at Olympic Village Vet for taking such good care of my dog, Sooka. They fit her in right away, gave her a really thorough check, and walked me through what to watch for at home. With their help, I felt confident keeping an eye on her, and she’s already doing so much better.

What I really appreciated was not just their skill but how kind and caring they were with both Sooka and me. You can tell they truly love what they do. Highly recommend this clinic!

Very caring staffs and we love dr. Elly. She cares about her patients so much and remember everything. Think from an owner's perspectives when proposing treatment options. All the staffs are super helpful and genuinely love animals. Highly recommend!

My cat Pierre is very shy and does not like going to the vet (shocking for a cat, I know). The vet and vet techs here are great with him - they do as much as they can while he's in his carrier where he feels safe and only bring him out when necessary. The vets are caring and take the time to listen and respond to your concerns. I have never felt pressured to agree to extra testing/procedures. Everything is well explained in person and in a follow up email after the appointment, which I really appreciate.
Bought dogfood, they seemed nice, allbeit a little pricey
Best staff that clearly care about my dogs. Thank you!!!

Have been taking my Cavalier to them for 4 years and always a positive experience.  All the vets and staff are good communicators and when my needy pup got spay they shared this photo of her getting extra love when she woke up.
Since the first time I brought Bandit to Olympic Village Veterinary they were very kind and really friendly and reasonable to I highly recommend Olympic village veterinary clinic

I was a loyal customer at Olympic Village Vet until I had a horrible experienced with Dr. Sarah who I believe is the owner. My youngest cat suffers from chronic UTIs and had been treated at OV clinic many times for this condition in the past with no issue.

My usual vet Dr. Jess was not available so I brought my cat to see Dr. Sarah. The entire experience was traumatizing for both me and my animal. Dr. Sarah did not believe me when I told her my cat had a UTI and instead accused me of having poisonous plants like Lillie’s in my house that must have made my cat sick. She insisted on keeping her there all day for testing only to discover she did in fact have a UTI. A $300 appointment turned into a $1300 one because of her insistence to hold her at the clinic.

She also wrote on my cats file that she had kidney disease solely based on speculation, which we now know after testing at a new clinic she does not. That is a very serious diagnosis to claim without any official testing and proof which caused me extreme emotional distress and panic.

I will never bring my animals back here after this horrible experience, this was over a year ago and I still think about it because of how traumatizing it was. The entire experience felt like emotional manipulation to make me spend more money. Absolutely horrible!
great staff

The kind of vets you dream of finding. I've never had the sense of feeling rushed. They always take their time to make sure they understand your needs and your pets needs. They are science-based and transparent, and will make sure you know everything you need before making decisions about care.

Love this place always super helpful and are able to see my cat quite soon, they always figure out what's wrong/what to do to help the staff give amazing care and are so sweet and patient with my cat every visit aswell

Fantastic staff, very friendly and welcoming. They’ve been patient and helpful with the myriad of requests I’ve sent their way.

You can tell they genuinely love animals and they always treat my cat with the upmost care and attention.

Chose to try this clinic after rescuing our second dog who is very anxious and unable to attend our usual clinic (as it is about 20 min further from me). I booked with a vet who was recommended through a trainer we had. After that initial visit, I felt very “sold to” from that vet and found she required a lot of unnecessary, pushing monthly check-ins and treatments (things my other vet never pushed for or required for our first dog and the second dog was the same breed and lifestyle). I want to acknowledge that my 8lb dog is anxious and restless however, it felt like the entire staff were quite inexperienced with this and it took like 20 mins to get blood taken and so many treats my dog came home and vomitted…

I won’t name names but chose to book with a different vet, Dr. Sarah after that experience and continue to give this clinic another chance with someone else. I did find the second vet I saw to be much more experienced and comfortable with what she recommended, which I felt hopeful about. Although there were still issues I had with Dr. Sarah’s recommendations and communication, she and one of the front desk staff Rachel, are the only reason this isn’t a 1 star review.

I have spent the last 4 months in and out of this clinic, working on a treatment plan to help my dogs anxiety. After a lot of trial and error (and money spent!), we never really got to a good place and I never left in person or telemedicine appointments  feeling very confident about the results after so long. I also found it incredibly inconvenient that this clinic requires 10 days to fill a prescription and can’t provide medication in-house, especially as someone who has to be regularly giving her dog meds and upping the doses to try more. It was truly a nightmare trying to plan for what I needed to get and when/on-time.  On top of that, there was only one front desk staff who was great, but the others were unfortunately so awful that it outweighed what she was able to offer.

When I finally got sick of this clinic, I decided to take my second dog to our usual vet on Friday. It was like a night and day difference. I felt so heard and seen for all of the issues I’d been experiencing at this clinic and made to feel difficult about when I’d raise the concerns with my vet here at Olympic Village. One major issue I had after seeing our usual vet was realizing that no one at Olympic Village had caught that I was severely over paying for the liquid bottle of Gabapentin, when my dog was on a dose (100mg) that was far cheaper and easier to purchase in a pill form. For reference - I was being charged more than double what I needed to pay, plus being left to wait 1-2 weeks for said refill.

Overall, I found majority of the staff unhelpful/rude/inexperienced, they were constantly confused and very clearly did not communicate/have a front end system that worked well. I was constantly left wasting time at the front while they tried to dig up invoices I had been emailed and asked to pay online, often trying to charge me twice. I felt like I was crazy for having pretty bare minimum expectations and as someone that has been and needs to be at the vet quite often right now as I work through a treatment plan with my dog, I was horribly disappointed by this clinic’s systems and most of the staff.

After trying to give Olympic Village months to make this work or improve for sheer convenience, I feel great about my decision of going somewhere further and better. I strongly encourage them to update their systems, improve their communication, be realistic about what they ask patients to do - as to not feel like a cash grab clinic, and find a way to fill medication faster.
Thank you Manbir!
Thank you Darcy!
Everyone here is so kind, considerate, helpful and transparent. I can’t recommend them enough, they are truly awesome! ❤️

I visited this vet after my friend accidentally dropped my Pomeranian. First, the veterinarian was unable to locate my dog’s microchip. Additionally, she failed to identify a dental issue that another vet at a different clinic detected with ease, as well as the microchip. She erroneously recommended a heart surgery. I really don't recom this place.
Thanks Alec!
Dr Longridge and the entire team were very professional, caring, kind, knowledgeable and patient. The clinic is clean. We had a great experience on our visit.

I have so much love for the team here! They have been nothing but amazing for our cat Ponyo over the last year and we're gutted we have to move away. Highly recommend, great communication via email or phone and always there to answer your questions! Thanks again for everything!

Been taking our puppy here since we got her. Love the experience every time as you can tell they genuinely care about your pet and take great care of them. My puppy is very shy and anxious and today she had to get sprayed. This involved leaving her there for most of the day by herself. I had no worries as I knew she was looked after and loved. I got updates throughout the day about how she was to keep my mind at ease. After every appointment they message me the next day without fail to check on my puppy. I would 100% recommend this clinic if you are looking for a vet. No matter which member of staff we have an appointment with the experience has always been excellent
Services always pushed. Rude, unhelpful.

I cannot give enough positive feedback for the team at Olympic Village Vet! We are SO happy we found them for our pups Billie and Bear.  All staff - from front desk to assistants to doctors - are incredible. Kind, patient, and extremely knowledgable. There is full transparency on pricing, and in my experience there have been no surprises this way. In an emergency, they helped direct us where to go, and even followed up afterward despite being seen at another clinic. They really care!! If you are looking for a new vet for your fur baby, do not hesitate to come here. They are an amazing team that are second to none. Many thanks, we are customers for life!

Incredibly caring, knowledgeable every step of the way. You can tell everyone absolutely loves animals there, and I felt like they took very good care of my cat Pancho there as if he was their own. I feel like I've finally found the right vet.
Staff are kind and knowledgeable. They’ve made us feel super comfortable and I would definitely recommend it to other dog parents.

We had such an incredible experience with the entire team when we brought in our eight month old pup. Dr. Emily was so amazing and took such great care of him. She took the time to answer any questions that we had and was so patient with our anxious pup through the whole visit. From the moment we walked in the door, the whole team was so helpful. You can tell everyone there loves what they do and is willing to care for your animal as much as you are. I can’t recommend them enough. Thank you for such a great experience!

I don’t how this happened but I thought I was writing a review for a chocolatier in another city. 🤣🤣🤣

Correction: this is a great vet that we always take our beautiful Coco. The staff are super nice and always very helpful.

….
Delicious chocolates but overpriced. Or simply I don’t understand good chocolates.

Cute mouse chocolates with the tail. Great as a gift.
Very kind and patient with my anxious dog.

Keen understanding of the cat mind. I’ve never seen a vet with this many treats on hand and very interestingly they had a basket with a blanket so the little rat could be more comfortable. Best vet I’ve been to.
